ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.2). Adds a full-screen "Work Control" bottom tab laid out like the vanilla Work tab: one row per free colonist, a fixed pawn name column on the left and a horizontal lane of movable WorkType cards on the right. There is one shared horizontal scroll for all rows, so moving it moves every lane together, and one outer vertical scroll over all pawn rows. Cards show the best relevant skill level and a temporary passion marker, wrap full WorkType names, and offer add (+), remove (x) and drag reorder; incapable types are grey and cannot be added or dragged. The first edit writes dense rank 1..N straight into each pawn's Pawn_WorkSettings priorities and calls Notify_UseWorkPrioritiesChanged, so the vanilla Work tab updates; per-pawn order is saved in a GameComponent. The previous per-pawn result table is removed. It also keeps the earlier work-type/giver ordering, split and merge tools, which never delete work types or givers. No profiles, schedules or equipment yet. Changes to the def-layer settings apply on restart. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
